PATTERN ANALYST INSIGHTS: trend_champion='ETS', seasonality_champion='ETS', recommended_method='median_or_trimmed_mean'. Narrative: ETS dominates all three champion categories with perfect trend correlation (1.0), highest seasonal correlation (0.33), and lowest RMSE (19.57). However, the series is highly unpredictable (spectral entropy 0.86) and models are redundant (error correlation 0.91), so robust median/trimmed_mean combinations are preferred over weighted stacking to avoid overfitting noise. Early horizon specialists (DWT variants) and late horizon specialists (NaiveMovingAverage, ARIMA) differ significantly, suggesting per-horizon selection could add value.
